limitations: Addresses join by exact BBL. A PLUTO address identifies a tax lot; several buildings on that lot can share the address. Missing addresses remain unknown.

Only constructed at-grade segments are rendered; paper streets, bridges, tunnels, ferry routes and nonphysical links are excluded. Street ribbons use supplied streetwidth where present; otherwise a thin centerline. They are not surveyed curb boundaries.
The focused view covers the selected building and its one-block vicinity, approximately 180 metres in each direction; it does not claim a cadastral block boundary.
